task: Close the RISC-V SoC profile slice for the Cellos HAL split and keep the scope to SoC facts, kernel platform consumption, and docs handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: hal/soc/riscv carries immutable RISC-V SoC profile facts only.
kernel/src/platform.rs consumes the profiles without changing PlatformInfo shape.
Docs and tracking files distinguish QEMU and compile evidence from deferred hardware runtime proof.
publicContracts: boards/ remains the board descriptor owner.
scoutSummary: The new crate is data-only; the kernel still owns DTB parsing, driver publication, and fallback handling. PLIC IRQ policy, boot fallback memory migration, and board descriptors remain out of scope.
